label: input digit 1 early in the original sequence (steps 0-4)
explanation: Update-gate unit that fires mainly when the input token is the digit 1 during the original phase at an early position (t <= 4); in_tok=1 carries ~85% of activation mass, and it is silent at t >= 5 regardless of token. At t=0 a leading 1 always fires (precision 1.0); at t=2 and t=3 a 1 fires ~60-70% of the time, at t=1 and t=4 only ~20-33%, and the residual variation was not explained by earlier digits or tokens to go. Magnitude is highest for a 1 at t=3 (or t=0). Weaker, smaller activations occur on early j, z, m and occasionally 0/x/c, and a tiny amount (~5% mass) at the first copy step (recall_idx 1), with the largest single activations at t=3 = first copy output in L=3 sequences that start with 1. Never fires on the delimiter or later copy steps.
